metadata.title: When Valorant Hands You 1 Kill and Even You’re Like ‘Nope, Not Me’
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just get that? Enemy probably hit ‘spectate mode’ by accident.
My aim was definitely on vacation but the game said ‘sure, why not.’
Only in Valorant do random moments turn into highlights.
Click if your best kill was pure fluke!

Tap if your aim’s as confused as mine!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
